'''EUW:''' K C#kcwin |checkboxAutoTeams=Yes |checkbox2=No |role=Top |issub1=No |istrainee1=No |issub2=No |istrainee2=No |issub3=No |istrainee3=No |issub4=No |istrainee4=No |issub5=No |istrainee5=No |checkbox3=No |stream=https://twitch.tv/canna |facebook=https://facebook.com/profile.php?id=100057158147281 |twitter=CannaXDXD |instagram=canna_00 |deeplol=https://www.deeplol.gg/pro/Canna |dpmlol=https://dpm.lol/pro/Canna |checkboxSuppressOrgNavbox=No |checkboxSBS=Yes |checkboxTOCR=Yes |checkbox-res=No |checkboxIsSub=No |checkboxPrev=No |issub26=No |istrainee26=No |issub27=No |istrainee27=No |issub28=No |istrainee28=No |issub29=No |istrainee29=No |issub30=No |istrainee30=No }} == Biography == == Trivia == * His ID '''Canna''' is based on the character Kanna Kamui from the anime [[wikipedia:en:Miss_Kobayashi's_Dragon_Maid|''Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid'']].[https://youtu.be/ZFtrI9VF_rI T1 Canna on being compared to Impact and Duke, which anime his IGN is based in | Ashley Kang] ''youtube.com'' * His role model is [[Khan]]. * Following his 3-0 victory over [[Gen.G]] in the [[LCK/2020 Season/Spring Season|LCK 2020 Spring Playoffs]] finals became a ''Royal Roader'', an unofficial achievement earned in Korea after winning a final in a major league as a rookie. * Was Diamond I in middle school.[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cTaxZmJEXYg&t=387 Wolf: Effort, I love you! | T1 WIN CAM Moments EP.1 [Translated]] ''youtube.com'' * Known as "The Pride of Andong", Andong being the city in Korea that Canna is from.[https://youtu.be/cTaxZmJEXYg?t=121 Wolf: Effort, I love you! | T1 WIN CAM Moments EP.1 [Translated]] ''youtube.com'' ** A banner for Canna was put up in Andong during LCK Spring 2020. [http://www.inven.co.kr/board/lol/4625/2617539] * Dubbed by Twitch chat as "GODNA" when performing well, and as "CAN NA" when performing badly. * Also has the moniker of "Solo Killing Machine" by Korean viewers, and "Solo Kill King" by English viewers for his high number of solo kills in the LCK. ** He was actually close to surpassing [[MaRin | MaRin's]] record in LCK Summer 2020. * Although the T1 KLEVV ad[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KUeq__RmAjE T1 X KLEVV 만들어 봐, 네 본체의 빛]''youtube.com'' that has been touted by some as cringe that transcends space and time, a really good picture of Canna came out of it.[https://www.facebook.com/T1LoL/photos/pcb.2725852250982256/2725849390982542]''facebook'' * He revealed [[Ellim]] recommended him to join the academy prior to get called for the [[T1]] main roster. [https://youtu.be/KPg0K7H_lyQ?t=221 Canna shares his story on how he became a pro League of Legends player [T1 Stream Highlight]] ''youtube.com'' * The second player to win both a title in the LCK ([[LCK/2020 Season/Spring Playoffs|LCK 2020 Spring]]) and in the LEC ([[LEC/2025 Season/Winter Playoffs|LEC 2025 Winter]]) after [[Huni]].[https://x.com/Sheep_Esports/status/1896375277108011359] ''x.com'' === Awards === * LCK 2nd All-Pro Team x1 (Summer 2020) * LEC 1st All-Pro Team x1 (Spring 2025) {{PlayerStatsTrivia}} == Tournament Results == {{PlayerResults|show=overviewpage}} {{PlayerShowmatchResults|show=overviewpage}} {{PlayerResults1v1|show=overviewpage}} == Media == {{PlayerMedia}} === Images === {{PlayerProfileGallery}} {{PlayerPageEnd}}
